## 4. Sprint 13 Kickoff: Real-Time Options Greeks Hedger & Dynamic Delta-Gamma Neutral Autobalancer

### 4.1 Vision & Scope
Sprint 13 introduces institutional-grade dynamic Greeks hedging for derivative traders and option writers:
1. **Multi-Leg Greeks Superposition:** Real-time continuous aggregation of portfolio Delta ($\Delta$), Gamma ($\Gamma$), Vega ($\mathcal{V}$), Theta ($\Theta$), and Rho ($\rho$).
2. **Delta Neutral Solver:** 1-instrument hedging solver computing exact underlying shares or ATM option contracts to eliminate directional market risk ($\Delta_{\text{net}} \to 0$).
3. **Delta-Gamma Neutral Autobalancer:** Simultaneous 2-instrument solver neutralizing both directional drift ($\Delta$) and convexity acceleration ($\Gamma$) using a linear system:
   $$\begin{pmatrix} \Delta_1 & \Delta_2 \\ \Gamma_1 & \Gamma_2 \end{pmatrix} \begin{pmatrix} n_1 \\ n_2 \end{pmatrix} = -\begin{pmatrix} \Delta_{\text{port}} \\ \Gamma_{\text{port}} \end{pmatrix}$$
4. **Statutory Tax Friction Guard:** Integrated SEBI/NSE tax estimation via `taxEngine.ts` to ensure hedging turnover costs do not exceed variance reduction benefits.
5. **Autobalancer Daemon:** Configurable background rebalancing daemon with customizable tolerance bands ($|\Delta| > \delta_{\text{tol}}$).
